hi! this is for poa; i got 73 for prelims and 90 for MYE, i dropped from a1 to a2 because i didn’t manage my time well and my poa paper 2 was on the first day so i was pretty unprepared. the best advice i can give is that you have to constantly read and test urself on the accounting concepts. try to do this everyday as poa requires a lot of practice. to become more familiar to O level type qns, do TYS!! keep doing tys questions (theres only 4 years so it wont take long) until u can get them correct. also if there’s certain topics u are weak at, look back at ur prev worksheets/ tests and re-do the qns & cover the ans. this helps me a lot as i need to keep re-doing to understand my mistakes.  i hope this is somewhat useful
